'''Kotal-De''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he led a squad of commandos into the [[Gorma-Koss]] on a mission to capture [[Jokull]], the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] king, during which he perished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kotal-De appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|imperial]] missions "The Gormak War" and "The Gormak King" on Voss.<ref name="SWTOR" /><ref name="The Gormak King" />
